episodes.title: Cults, FLDS & Sam Bateman: Nomz on Netflix #1 Documentary Trust Me: The False Prophet
episodes.description:
Cults, FLDS, Sam Bateman and the Netflix #1 Documentary Trust Me: The False Prophet — Nomz tells the story in her own words. Born into the FLDS, she takes us inside what life under Sam Bateman's control really looked like, and explains why she says "no one ever joins a cult." She opens up to Julie Lokun and Mika Altidor about her family being torn apart under Warren Jeffs, the almost two years in custody she calls both the best and worst thing that ever happened to her, the 300+ books she read behind bars, and the music she's now writing on her own terms.

Content note: This episode includes discussion of coercive control and sexual abuse. Please take care while listening.
